object.body:
Dear ${__recipient.name},

The ${requestedObjectName} entitlement has been assigned

This entitlement requires activation before each use. To activate this entitlement, visit MySailPoint > Launchpad > Just-In-Time Access

#if ($removeDate)

Your access to ${requestedObjectName} is scheduled to end on ${removeDate}.

#end
Thanks,
The ${__global.productName} Team
object.description: Sent to the identity when a standing entitlement assignment is converted to Just-In-Time access and must be activated before each use.
object.name: Standing Access Converted to Just-In-Time
object.subject: ${requestedObjectName} has been assigned
